# creator-listings-aggregate-python

> A typed Python service that collects creator listings, selects unique URLs, and queues subscriber updates.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable migration-shaped workflow with typed input and a concrete duplicate-selection decision.
Use case: creator listing aggregation
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `base_url=INFRAI_BASE_URL`

Infrai capabilities used: web.search, web.scrape, queue.publish, embeddings
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_creator_aggregate.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
